user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: Websites surfaced in ChatGPT search results.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates the safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs actions initiated by users in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits web pages triggered by user actions, not for automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for AI model development and training datasets.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot via robots.txt to exclude materials from training datasets.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to support Claude AI users' questions.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt to prevent retrieval for user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt to prevent indexing for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Build Google's search indexes and perform product-specific crawls and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Google Images, Google Video, Google News, and Discover.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawl images for Google products and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images, logos, and favicons.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawl videos for video-related Google Search features and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Fetch pages for Search testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools; no effect on Google Search or other products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for internal research, development, and team-specific fetches.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible content for various product teams; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Execute crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects site owner crawls for Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Control use of content for training Gemini models and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Controls training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and trains Apple foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls and renders web content across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines usage of crawled data for training Apple generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Controls data usage only; does not crawl webpages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Registered content URLs on Apple Podcasts; does not follow robots.txt.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl shared content on Meta apps to display title, description, and thumbnail.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt; may bypass for security checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Navigates the web to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web to train foundation models or index content.
user_agents.opt_out: Add disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch links at user request and support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches individual links at user request to complete tasks on websites.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are user-requested.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to power Bing search and Copilot generative AI experiences.
user_agents.scope: Public web pages across the internet for indexing and AI answer generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Bingbot user-agent via robots.txt rules.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Captures page snapshots and previews for search results and previews.
user_agents.scope: Public web pages requested for preview generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow BingPreview user-agent via robots.txt rules.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services and trains Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to improve Amazon products and services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt allow/disallow directives, rel=nofollow, or noarchive/noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services like Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for search experiences; does not crawl for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt directives for Amzn-SearchBot or directives given to other search bots.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches live web information to answer user queries on their behalf.
user_agents.scope: Live web fetching initiated by users; does not crawl for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions may not follow all robots.txt directives.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing open data for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset of the web, checking robots.txt and sitemaps.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using CCBot or request addition to opt-out registry.
